name: Akaki
source:
"Huh? Me? I'm Akaki. A-ka-ki, alright? Not Akagi. I used to be the best programmer at Iris Corporation... But ever since Mai showed up... ugh, forget it! Just leave me alone already! I'm not staying at this company much longer anyway!"

A programmer at Iris Corporation who often tries to act like a lead. She constantly clashes with [url=/c160574]Mai[/url]. It's probably because Mai has made her look inferior.

Her snideness makes her a handful, but the company's too busy to consider firing her. Whether that's good for her or not is up for debate... Later in the story, she experiences an unexpected turning point. She also runs a fashion website called Venus, which seems to play a role in that.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=akaki]official website[/url]]
